datasets.title: UNHCR Global Trends: Forced Displacement in 2021 Data
datasets.description: This dataset contains 23 data tables on global trends in forced displacement in 2021. The data provide trends, national level summaries and the demographic composition of refugees, asylum-seekers, Venezuelans displaced abroad, internally displaced persons (IDPs), returnees (refugees and IDPs), stateless persons, and other persons of concern to UNHCR.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/unhcr-global-trends-forced-displacement-in-2021-data]

lineage.description: UNHCR compiled national-level administrative data on forced displacement populations reported by governments according to their own definitions and methodologies. The dataset aggregates 23 tables of global trends covering demographic composition and population counts of refugees, asylum-seekers, IDPs, returnees, and stateless persons for 2021.

sources.name: UNHCR - The UN Refugee Agency
sources.description: Government-reported data on forced displacement populations including refugees, asylum-seekers, IDPs, returnees, and stateless persons compiled from national administrations using their own definitions and collection methods.
